technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with overbought RSI(9) and golden cross, but intermediate trend weakness and lack of ADX confirmation limit conviction for a swing entry.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI(9) overbought with EMA 9/21 golden cross and Hull flip provide short-term momentum entry signal in extreme fear sentiment (contrarian opportunity) near support at 30.51.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar, elevated credit spreads) with price below 200-EMA, no ADX trend confirmation, no volume support, high earnings risk in 38 days, and zero fundamental/institutional conviction—risk/reward heavily skewed to downside.
